Promise combinators

Promise.all requires all inputs to fulfill; allSettled returns every result; race adopts the first settlement; any
fulfills on the first success or rejects with AggregateError if all reject.

Requests Jගොඩක් එකට handle කරන්න combinators තිJයනවා. all() එකකට reject වුJණාත් aggregate එක reject Jවනවා. allSettled() හැම result එකම ලබාJදනවා. race() මුලින් settle Jවන එක; any() මුලින් fulfill Jවන එක.

Interview question: Does Promise.all cancel other requests on rejection?
Answer: No. It rejects the aggregate promise; underlying work may continue unless explicitly canceled.
Remember: All success; settled all; race first; any success.
Practice: Predict all, race and any for one rejected and one fulfilled promise.
